page_title: LAZ 3-3 TOR | Lazio v Torino 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+13' 3 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Franco Israel no chance!
90+12' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+12' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+10' It’s a PENALTY to Lazio after the VAR review!
90+7' Referee Marco Piccinini makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+7' PENALTY APPEAL by Lazio, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+6' Today's referee Marco Piccinini rightly decides to book Taty Castellanos (Lazio) for his harsh tackle.
90+5' Marco Piccinini sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+4' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Torino can stand using VAR.
90+3' 2 - 3 Saul Coco (Torino) scores with a fine header! The goalkeeper was unable to make a block, despite the ball going into the middle of the goal.
90+3' Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

90+2' Che Adams (Torino) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Torino.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nuno Tavares will be replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
90' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is penalised for a foul. Marco Piccinini had a clear view and blows his whistle.
88' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
88' A pass from Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is intercepted by Franco Israel and the move breaks down.
87' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) was probably a bit loose with his words to Marco Piccinini, who decides to show him a yellow.
86' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
86' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
85' The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.

84' Ambitious effort from Ali Dembele (Torino). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) for Boulaye Dia.
79' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Giovanni Simeone is replaced by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
79' Marcus Pedersen is substituted due to injury. Marco Baroni gives a chance to Ali Dembele (Torino).
77' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
73' 2 - 2 Goal! Niels Nkounkou provides Che Adams (Torino) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the top right corner. 2:2.
71' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
70' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Corner kick. Torino will have an opportunity.
70' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Masina (Torino) replacing Adrien Tameze.
70' Substitution. Che Adams (Torino) replaces Nikola Vlasic.

69' A cross from Marcus Pedersen (Torino) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Torino have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
68' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
67' Here is a change. Pedro is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
67' Substitution. Toma Basic did his best and is replaced by Reda Belahyane (Lazio).
66' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
65' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
63' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' A substitution has been made. Valentino Lazaro is replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Torino).
60' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Cesare Casadei (Torino) for his blatant foul.
59' Adrien Tameze (Torino) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
56' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Franco Israel.
56' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.
54' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) attempts to find Pedro, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
52' Toma Basic (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Adrien Tameze (Torino) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

48' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
47' What was Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Marco Piccinini has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Kristjan Asllani (Torino) took the corner.

45+1' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Toma Basic (Lazio), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.

42' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
41' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
40' 2 - 1 Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Franco Israel with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
38' The game is interrupted as Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is flagged offside.
38' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Franco Israel is alert and denies him.
36' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
35' None of the Torino players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

35' A big opportunity is wasted by Kristjan Asllani (Torino), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Ivan Provedel pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort. Now Torino have a corner.
32' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
32' A cross is whipped into the box by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) and Giovanni Simeone controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
31' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) tries to find Taty Castellanos with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.

24' 1 - 1 Goal! That is a fantastic finish by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) from just outside the box. He wastes little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flies past the goalkeeper into the top of the net.

24' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Ivan Provedel inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
23' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Lazio have a free kick.
16' 0 - 1 Giovanni Simeone (Torino) pounces on a rebound inside the box from a Marcus Pedersen shot and sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:1.
13' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Piccinini no option but to blow his whistle.
8' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

6' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
6' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivan Provedel, who smothers the ball.
5' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
2' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The first half has started.
Torino will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Piccinini.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
